total.description: Total number of matches. Absent when the search paged by cursor and the total is not known -- it is never estimated.

address.description: A hex address, or SPACE:offset for a symbol in a named address space such as EXTERNAL. Ghidra renders the latter without a 0x prefix because it is not a number.

truncated.description: True when results were left out. Separate from has_more/cursor, which say how to fetch the rest: a hard per-request cap truncates with nothing to page to.

returned.description: Entries on this page. Always present; unlike total it never depends on whether the search matched anything.
